whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mom's restaurant party hall,

I noticed your party hall has strong 4.0★ reviews in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for banquet and event bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant aur party hall ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, event menu, aur party gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/moms

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Mom's restaurant party hall team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first event showcase and direct WhatsApp booking for Bihta customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu aur photos setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
